Thanks for the detailed report. I searched existing issues for "getNames infinite loop" and "task.suite cycle hang" and found no duplicate. I confirmed `getNames` exists at `packages/runner/src/utils/tasks.ts:58`. I could not read the function body in this session, so I'm relying on your snippet, which shows a `while (current?.suite)` loop with no cycle guard.

One thing is unclear: your repro builds the cycle by hand. The runner normally assigns `.suite` from the collector, so a cycle shouldn't arise in a normal run. Could you share a minimal repro (StackBlitz or a repo) that produces the cycle through vitest's own APIs, such as a custom runner, pool or plugin? Also say which of those your production setup uses. That will help us decide whether the right fix is a guard in `getNames` or fixing whatever creates the cycle.
